source_title: Health policy launch, Papakura, 1993
source_description: Prime Minister Jim Bolger at the podium in Papakura, September 1993. To his left is a larger-than-life size poster of local MP John Robertson."Prime Minister Jim Bolger was in Papakura last week launching the National Party's health policy. Some points in the health policy include improving child health services, improving the health of Maori and Pacific Islanders and improving mental health services. Other health priorities are to look at hospice services, rehabilitation services and replacing waiting lists with a booking service. After launching the policy he then visited Middlemore Hospital to see first hand the problems with the health system." (Papakura Courier, 29 September 1993, p. 5)

source_title: African Heritage Festival
source_description: Printed in black ink on white paper is a promotional poster for an African Heritage Festival which took place at Chico State College. According to the CSC student newspaper, Wildcat (4/15/1970), the festival included lectures (including Dr. Nathan Hare, the founder and former chair of the Black Studies department at San Francisco State University), music (Matiwana Manana performing a "Zulu cultural show" alongside African Heritage Dance and Music Ensemble), and an art exhibition that included art from a number of artists shown at Brockman Gallery: Gloria Bohanon, Bernie Casey, Marion Epting, Bill Martin, Charles White, and Milton Young.
